sentence: - **Setup:** To add Hydrogen to an existing project, run `npx @shopify/hydrogen@latest setup` in the folder that contains `package.json`.
context: ## Hydrogen 2026-10

Hydrogen `2026-10` works in any framework that runs server code, such as Next.js, React Router, Nuxt, Astro, SvelteKit, or SolidStart. Write UI, routing, and data loading in the developer's framework. Use Hydrogen for the Storefront API client, the cart, products, collections, search, customer accounts, money formatting, analytics, Shop Pay, and the Shopify routes that every storefront needs, such

- **Docs:** Pass version `2026-10` to the docs search. Use the [Hydrogen 2026-10 reference](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/hydrogen/2026-10) and the [Hydrogen guides](https://shopify.dev/docs/storefronts/hydrogen). Skip pages under `https://shopify.dev/docs/storefronts/headless/legacy`.

- **Setup:** To add Hydrogen to an existing project, run `npx @shopify/hydrogen@latest setup` in the folder that contains `package.json`. The command installs `@shopify/hydrogen` and copies Hydrogen's skills into `.claude/skills/` and `.agents/skills/`. Then follow the `hydrogen-setup` skill to wire Hydrogen into the app. Follow [Add Hydrogen to an existing project](https://shopify.dev/docs/storef

- **Skills:** Before you write code for a feature, read the skill for that feature, such as `hydrogen-cart-ui` for a cart UI. If a project on Hydrogen `2026-10` is missing the skills, run `npx @shopify/hydrogen skills sync`. To update a project on Hydrogen `2026-10`, update `@shopify/hydrogen` to the latest `2026.10` release, and then run `npx @shopify/hydrogen skills sync`.
